senses.gloss: (= אחרא, v. חוֹרִי), יומא ח׳ next day, v. יוֹמָחְרָא.
units: <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 20:16">Targ. II Chr. XX, 16</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>אחרא</he>).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 17a:15">B. Mets. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>למחר וליומא ח׳</he> (Ms. H. a. oth. <he>אוחרא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) to-morrow or the day after.
